request: Rename the `watched` field of watchlist items to `seen` everywhere.

requests.title: Watchlist > navigates via the title link without toggling watched
requests.reason: The test asserts `store.items()[0].watched`, a field that no longer exists on `WatchItem` after the `watched` → `seen` rename. Changed only that property read to `.seen`; the assertion's intent (navigating via the title link does not change the item's seen state) is unchanged. No other tests were modified.
